This is not a "call the API and wrap a prompt" role. We need someone who understands what's happening inside the model, not just how to invoke it. What you'll be doing (hands-on) Model design & architecture Designing and modifying model architecture, not limited to using pre-built models off the shelf Building and deploying multimodal LLM / VLLM pipelines (text + vision + reasoning) Fine-tuning models (LoRA / QLoRA / full-parameter) for domain-specific medical tasks Choosing the right model(s) for the problem, rather than defaulting to one approach Devising dynamic, learning-based approaches over static loss functions, models that adapt to new data rather than just memorizing it Working with knowledge graphs (Neo4j), medical ontologies, and the interplay between graph structures and RAG Data Building robust pipelines for unstructured, messy, regulated data: cleaning, normalization, feature engineering, and pre/post-processing Extracting and mapping medical data from sources like OpenFDA and RxNorm Enforcing strict separation between client datasets, no cross-use of one client's data to train general-purpose models Implementing quality checks and validation pipelines throughout the data and deployment lifecycle Validation, safety & trust Implementing post-inference automated validation, confidence scoring, and output safety layers, this is a hard requirement given we work with real medical data where errors can be fatal Balancing probabilistic and deterministic trust layers Designing adaptive, agile validation layers (not one-size-fits-all static checks) Building model evaluation matrices and rigorous A/B testing and benchmarking Evaluating performance beyond static/offline metrics: drift, reliability, real-world failure modes Reducing error propagation and interdependency risk across the pipeline Production & scale Owning systems end-to-end: data → inference → validation → production → Proper documentation (key requirement) Productionizing models: serving, monitoring, iteration Optimizing for scalability, cost, speed, and accuracy, and consciously balancing these against each other, including the tradeoff between latency, cost, and verification depth Monitoring model drift and implementing continuous learning to sustain accuracy Grasp of what it takes to scale a product across multiple jurisdictions and countries Adapting pipelines to comply with US and EU healthcare data privacy and sovereignty requirements (HIPAA, GDPR) Working closely with product & engineering to ship regulatory-aware AI Collaborating directly with the engineering teams of our global tech partner, on whose platform our products are integrated and launched What we're looking for Genuinely LLM/modern-AI-relevant experience, not primarily classical/legacy computer vision experience Proven track record building products end-to-end: from model design/architecture through to deployment, not just fine-tuning or inference work Outside-the-box problem solving. Novel solutions over textbook ones Strong ML fundamentals plus real development and production experience (not research-only) Comfortable owning ambiguity and taking real ownership of systems Startup mindset: pragmatic and impact-driven Ability to develop proprietary models by changing architecture and components, and not just fine-tuning. Qualifications 3+ years of experience as a machine learning engineer Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (Preferred) Experience in heavily regulated environments. HIPAA, GDPR, and ideally medical informatics, FHIR, HL7 (Preferred) Knowledge of adversarial attacks on ML models and AI security best practices Experience with graph neural networks (GNNs), multimodal AI, and federated learning Contributions to AI research or publications in top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, etc.) Experience building post-inference automated validation pipelines Technical stack (flexible, not rigid) Python, PyTorch / TensorFlow VLLMs (vision-language models) and/or vLLM-style serving and deployment LLM frameworks & APIs, with fine-tuning experience (LoRA / QLoRA / full-parameter) Neo4j / graph databases and knowledge graph–RAG integration Data pipelines: cleaning, validation, and orchestration for messy, regulated data Model serving & evaluation infrastructure Healthcare data experience (FHIR, HL7, OpenFDA, RxNorm) is a strong plus Why this role Ownership Global deployment at scale Real, tangible impact in healthcare AI Perks Travel to the US and Europe Package alignment with product success Scalable financial upside Publish research and white papers Competitions and conferences Medical insurance and exponential learning/exposure to cutting-edge ML and RL Off-sites to fun places Well-being packages (therapy, gym, nutrition plans) A thorough technical assessment will be conducted covering knowledge, hands-on experience, and code.
